stem.alt: Skeletal formula of retinol: a cyclohexene ring with gem-dimethyl and methyl groups, linked to a conjugated polyene chain ending in CH2OH.
stem.label: retinol

stem.text: Under appropriate conditions, acidified $\text{KMnO}_4\text{(aq)}$ can be used to break apart $\text{C=C}$ bonds.
After these bonds have been broken, further oxidation of the fragments may occur.
Under which conditions is the acidified $\text{KMnO}_4\text{(aq)}$ used and what do the final oxidation products include?

A.text: cold, dilute; aldehydes and carboxylic acids

B.text: cold, dilute; ketones and carboxylic acids

C.text: hot, concentrated; aldehydes and carboxylic acids

D.text: hot, concentrated; ketones and carboxylic acids
